geography.geometry_modification: none beyond integer quantization and canonical ordering

identity.bin_caveat: BIN can be duplicated and borough-million values are unknown

fields.the_geom: top-down building perimeter; Polygon or MultiPolygon
fields.name: limited commonly known name; not actively maintained
fields.bin: Department of City Planning building identifier with documented duplicate and unknown values
fields.base_bbl: tax lot physically containing the footprint, subject to synchronization caveats
fields.construction_year: completion year; zero or null means unavailable
fields.feature_code: official building feature classification including placeholder value 1003
fields.ground_elevation: lowest ground-level elevation with source-dependent accuracy
fields.height_roof: roof height above ground; zero or null means unavailable; output unit not asserted

excluded_fields.shape_area: official documentation says do not use
excluded_fields.shape_length: official documentation says do not use
excluded_fields.objectid: synthetic key; official documentation directs users to DOITT_ID
